preconditions.description: The length of the string s is between 3 and 5000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all('a' <= c <= 'z' for c in stdin)
preconditions.description: The string s consists only of small English letters.

postconditions.expression: isinstance(stdout, str) and stdout.strip() != '' and float(stdout.strip()) >= 0.0 and float(stdout.strip()) <= 1.0
postconditions.description: The output is a valid probability value between 0 and 1.

postconditions.expression: abs(float(stdout.strip()) - (sum(max(1.0 / len([k for k in range(len(stdin)) if stdin[(k + 1) % len(stdin)] == stdin[(k + 1) % len(stdin)] and len([j for j in range(len(stdin)) if stdin[(j + 1) % len(stdin)] == stdin[(k + 1) % len(stdin)] and stdin[(j + 2) % len(stdin)] == stdin[(k + 2) % len(stdin)]]) == 1]) for k in range(len(stdin)) if stdin[k] == stdin[k])) / len(stdin))) < 1e-6
postconditions.description: The output represents the optimal winning probability: the sum over all possible first letters of the probability of that letter occurring times the maximum probability of uniquely identifying the shift given that first letter by optimally choosing a second position to reveal.
